work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CCXVI (address LF48072–48074) appoints the Observant Franciscan Perpetuo da Solero, bishop of Fessei i.p.i., vicar apostolic of the new vicariate of Egypt and Arabia; LF48096 → LF48105 across own provenance LF48099 and page number 328 LF48102; complete 28 May 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF48077–48077; the source closing at LF48151–48154 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava maii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
